title: Zach Dell co-founded Base Power in 2023; now valued at $13 billion it has installed more than 23,000 home batteries
summary_full: Base Power, led by Zach Dell, is revolutionizing residential energy with its advanced battery storage solutions. Having secured a staggering one billion dollars in funding, the company now boasts a valuation of thirteen billion dollars. With thousands of batteries quickly being installed, they are expanding their reach into additional states.
